text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- The total cost of Expo '98 is expected to be around 400 billion escudos, well above initial estimates, the newspaper learned.
- Prime Minister Antonio Guterres is concerned over the debate about the possible exclusion of "Club Med" countries from the first stage of Economic and Monetary Union.
- The privatisation of electricity company EDP-Electricidade de Portugal on Lisbon stock exchange expected to bring in 340 billion escudos.
- Medicine prices to be frozen this year.
- Government seeking sponsors to help pay for Expo '98.
- Dairy company Lactogal seeking opportunities to expand in Angola and Mozambique.
